headline: Senior DevOps Engineer | CKA | AWS Certified Solutions Architect
summary: Result-oriented DevOps Engineer with 6 years of experience in automating, scaling, and monitoring cloud infrastructure. Proven track record in implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and robust CI/CD pipelines for high-traffic applications. Strong expertise in Kubernetes orchestration and security-first infrastructure design. Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and AWS Solutions Architect with a deep focus on optimizing operational efficiency and system reliability.

experiences.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Architected and managed production-grade Kubernetes clusters on AWS EKS, improving deployment frequency by 40%.
Automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform and Ansible, reducing manual environment setup time from days to minutes.
Designed and implemented a centralized logging and monitoring solution using ELK stack and Prometheus/Grafana for a global SIEM platform.
Lead the migration of legacy monolithic services to a microservices architecture using Docker and Helm.
Mentored junior engineers on cloud-native best practices and security hardening of Linux servers.

experiences.title: DevOps Engineer
description: Developed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab CI for multiple client projects across North America and Nepal.
Optimized cloud costs by 25% through the implementation of AWS Auto Scaling groups and Reserved Instances.
Managed RDS databases and implemented automated backup and recovery strategies.
Collaborated with development teams to containerize applications and ensure environment parity across Dev, Staging, and Production.

experiences.title: Associate Infrastructure Engineer
description: Provided 24/7 infrastructure support for a global workforce platform, ensuring 99.9% uptime.
Automated routine server maintenance tasks using Bash and Python scripting.
Assisted in the configuration and management of Nginx load balancers and VPC peering.
Monitored system health and responded to incidents using PagerDuty and Nagios.
